title: Mirror Match — Stereochemistry
author: Dr. Dan (ItsDrDan)
description: Practice CHEM 3B stereochemistry (Sections 3.2, 5.5, 8.2–8.3 and 10.1) from 5 main options: Chiral Carbons (key terms, spot the labeled chiral carbon, count chiral carbons in drawn molecules and amino acids, 2ⁿ stereoisomers), Isomer Relationships (identical, enantiomers, diastereomers or constitutional isomers from wedge-and-dash drawings, including flipped and rotated drawings), Cis & Trans (alkenes and rings), Fischer & D/L (D or L sugars and amino acids, compare Fischer projections, pick the enantiomer) and Health & Clinic (chiral drugs: thalidomide, racemic ibuprofen, single-enantiomer drugs, receptors). Every structure is generated and checked by code. Skill Check Prep gives 10 questions and a study plan; Exam Practice uses the textbook's chirality and isomer question banks. Mistake-specific feedback, step-by-step help, a cheat sheet, XP, ranks, 11 achievements and Mira the mirror mascot.
